mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sd_user_model (id, title, model_name, model_name_zh, addition_tag, hash, file_name, url, config, type, belong_user_id, is_open, publish_status, crt_time) VALUE (#{id},#{title},#{modelName},#{modelNameZh},#{additionTag},#{hash},#{fileName},#{url},#{config},#{type},#{belongUserId},#{isOpen},#{publishStatus},#{crtTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title=VALUES(title),model_name=VALUES(model_name),file_name=VALUES(file_name),config=VALUES(config)
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT A.id, A.classify_id, A.title, A.model_name, A.model_name_zh, A.model_strength, A.addition_tag, A.hash, A.file_name, A.url, A.remark, A.type, A.is_open, A.belong_user_id, A.publish_status, A.crt_time, A.is_user_del,B.user_name AS belong_user_name FROM sd_user_model AS A LEFT JOIN sys_user AS B ON A.belong_user_id=B.user_id LEFT JOIN sd_user_model_classify_tmp AS C ON A.id=C.model_id LEFT JOIN sd_user_model_share AS D ON A.id=D.model_id WHERE A.publish_status=1
AND D.user_id=#{userId}) AND (A.type=0 OR A.is_open=1 OR (A.type=1 AND A.belong_user_id=#{userId}) OR D.user_id=#{userId})
AND A.classify_id=1 AND C.classify_id=#{dto.classifyId}
AND A.model_name_zh LIKE CONCAT('%',#{dto.searchValue},'%') ORDER BY A.id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT A.*,B.user_name AS belong_user_name FROM sd_user_model AS A LEFT JOIN sys_user AS B ON A.belong_user_id=B.user_id
AND A.publish_status=#{dto.publishStatus}
AND A.model_name_zh LIKE CONCAT('%',#{dto.modelNameZh},'%')
AND B.user_name LIKE CONCAT(#{dto.belongUserName},'%')
AND A.crt_time BETWEEN CONCAT(#{dto.startDate},' 00:00:00') AND CONCAT(#{dto.endDate},' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY A.id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT A.*,B.user_name AS belong_user_name FROM sd_user_model AS A LEFT JOIN sys_user AS B ON A.belong_user_id=B.user_id LEFT JOIN sd_user_model_share AS C ON A.id=C.model_id WHERE A.id=#{id} AND A.publish_status=1 AND (A.type=0 OR A.is_open=1 OR (A.type=1 AND A.belong_user_id=#{userId}) OR C.user_id=#{userId})

SELECT DISTINCT B.id, A.crt_time, A.use_times, B.classify_id, B.title, B.model_name, B.model_name_zh, B.hash, B.file_name, B.config, B.url, B.remark, B.type, IFNULL(A.model_strength,B.model_strength) AS model_strength, B.is_open, B.belong_user_id, B.publish_status,C.user_name AS belong_user_name,B.addition_tag FROM sd_user_model_log AS A LEFT JOIN sd_user_model AS B ON A.lora_model_id=B.id LEFT JOIN sys_user AS C ON B.belong_user_id=C.user_id LEFT JOIN sd_user_model_share AS D ON B.id=D.model_id WHERE A.user_id=#{userId} AND B.publish_status=1 AND (B.type=0 OR B.is_open=1 OR (B.type=1 AND B.belong_user_id=#{userId}) OR D.user_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY A.crt_time DESC,A.use_times DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT B.id, A.crt_time, A.use_times, B.classify_id, B.title, B.model_name, B.model_name_zh, B.file_name, B.url, B.remark, B.type, IFNULL(A.model_strength,B.model_strength) AS model_strength, B.is_open, B.belong_user_id, B.publish_status, B.task_id,C.user_name AS belong_user_name FROM sd_user_model_log AS A LEFT JOIN sd_user_model AS B ON A.lora_model_id=B.id LEFT JOIN sys_user AS C ON B.belong_user_id=C.user_id LEFT JOIN sd_user_model_share AS D ON B.id=D.model_id WHERE A.user_id=#{userId} AND B.publish_status=1 AND (B.type=0 OR B.is_open=1 OR (B.type=1 AND B.belong_user_id=#{userId}) OR D.user_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY A.crt_time DESC,A.use_times DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT A.id, A.task_id, A.classify_id, A.title, A.model_name, A.model_name_zh, A.model_strength, A.file_name, A.url, A.remark, A.type, A.is_open, A.belong_user_id, A.publish_status, A.crt_time, A.is_user_del,B.user_name AS belong_user_name FROM sd_user_model AS A LEFT JOIN sys_user AS B ON A.belong_user_id=B.user_id LEFT JOIN sd_user_model_classify_tmp AS C ON A.id=C.model_id LEFT JOIN sd_user_model_share AS D ON A.id=D.model_id WHERE A.publish_status=1
AND D.user_id=#{userId}) AND (A.type=0 OR A.is_open=1 OR (A.type=1 AND A.belong_user_id=#{userId}) OR D.user_id=#{userId})
AND A.classify_id=1 AND C.classify_id=#{dto.classifyId}
AND A.model_name_zh LIKE CONCAT('%',#{dto.searchValue},'%') ORDER BY A.id DESC
